name: FFmpeg In-Place Wipe Reveal With Alpha Mask
use_when: A foreground text, glow, graphic, or video layer should reveal in place without sliding across the screen.
A normal transition would move the top layer but the design calls for a wipe mask.
Direct xfade behavior causes black areas where transparent foreground should remain empty.
avoid_when: A simple full-screen transition between two opaque clips is the real goal.
A Remotion CSS mask is already available and easier to control.
The mask inputs cannot be matched for resolution, fps, duration, pixel format, and timebase.
The foreground does not need transparency or in-place reveal behavior.

timeline_pattern.pattern: black_source + white_source -> xfade_wipe_mask -> foreground_prepared_in_place -> alphamerge -> overlay_over_background
timeline_pattern.position_rule: Foreground stays at its final position; the mask moves, not the foreground.
timeline_pattern.transparency_rule: If foreground has existing alpha, verify whether the reveal mask replaces or should multiply that alpha.

motion.rule: The wipe should complete before the viewer needs the full foreground readable.

keyframe_values.short_form_text: 6-15 frames at 30 fps for fast in-place text reveals.
keyframe_values.lower_third_or_title: 12-24 frames at 30 fps for calmer reveals.
keyframe_values.tolerance: Reveal should land within the intended beat/phrase tolerance and hold after it completes.

sound.rule: Place any whoosh or shimmer on the visible reveal edge, not merely at the start of the generated mask.

captions.rule: Do not let the wipe reveal cover or duplicate ordinary captions unless the foreground text is replacing them.

color.rule: Check transparent foreground edges for black contamination after the wipe mask is attached.

implementation.ffmpeg: Generate a black-to-white xfade wipe mask, attach it with alphamerge to a foreground already positioned in place, then overlay the result over the background.
implementation.remotion: Equivalent behavior is a frame-driven CSS mask or clip-path on the foreground layer; export transparent if compositing later.
implementation.blender: Animate a wipe matte across a foreground layer in compositor while the foreground transform stays fixed.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: Use a Split mask keyframed across a compounded foreground layer rather than moving the layer itself.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Use Linear Wipe or a track matte on the foreground layer while keeping Position fixed.

common_mistakes: Animating the foreground position instead of the mask.
Using xfade directly on transparent foreground and accepting black transparency failures.
Using a wipe mask with mismatched properties.
Finishing to a non-alpha format when the output is meant to remain a reusable overlay.
qc: Foreground stays in place through the reveal.
Mask preview shows the intended wipe direction.
Existing transparent areas remain transparent after reveal.
Mask and foreground dimensions, fps, duration, pixel format, and timebase match.
No black rectangle appears behind transparent foreground areas.
